messages:
Jared: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance segment. Post any runway/budget/procurement Qs here — we'll answer live.
Maya: Headline: runway ~18 months on plan; downside scenarios and controls below.
Ravi: can you break down the $/month burn by category?
Maya: Sure — ~ $3.2M/mo: payroll ~$1.4M, infra/GPU ~$1.25M, sales/marketing ~$350k, misc ops ~$200k. Rounded.
Sofia: if bookings miss by 15%, what actions kick in?
Jared: Triggered actions: selective hiring freeze (noncritical roles), pause major brand spend, renegotiate large vendor contracts; board notified if runway <12 months.
Ravi: procurement thresholds? last renewal surprised us.
ProcurementBot: New rules: purchases > $5k need Finance review; > $25k need Legal + CFO signoff. Auto-hold for renewals > $15k. Submit via internal procure link and tag "expedite" for customer-impacting buys.
Sofia: SLA on reviews?
ProcurementBot: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k-$25k: 5 business days; >$25k: 10 business days. Expedited triage for true customer-impacting requests (expect ~24hrs).
Maya: Managers can approve up to $1k for tooling; Directors + Finance for $1k-$5k. Larger requests need Finance signoff.
Jared: We'll post the updated approval matrix and a short FAQ in #finance-docs. DM Maya or me for exceptions.
Sofia: thanks, closing thread.
